requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Getting Started with Memotto"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Memotto is a note-taking app that lets you bring text, tables, and images together in one place."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This guide uses examples featuring Yamanashi-san from PR and Takanashi-san from Sales to explain how it works."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "A short note attached to a page is called a \"Quick Note\"."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yamanashi-san records the decisions from meetings in Quick Notes."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yamanashi-san marks important spots with Sticky notes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You can add up to ten one-line notes per page."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Using it as a team"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Takanashi's sales team first created a Space."}, {"id": 2, "text": "The place inside a Space that everyone can see is called the \"Commons\"."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Anyone can post a note to the Commons."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Takanashi-san shares the sales schedule on the Commons every morning."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can invite members to a Space by email."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once an admin approves, you can join right away."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Member permissions can also be changed for each hiroba (space)."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and Revisions"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are saved automatically and synced to all of your devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can keep editing while offline, and changes sync as soon as you reconnect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can restore an earlier version from the page's Revisions."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Ms. Yamanashi got back a passage she had deleted by accident."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tips for organizing"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Pinning important pages is convenient."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes in Hiroba become easier to find when you add tags."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can create tags freely. ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Takanashi-san sorts tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The same tags can also be used for a single line."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "With search, you can look for both Hiroba and Hitokoto at the same time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "If you can't find what you need, try widening the search scope."}]}
